`clearOrigin`), about 0.1 KiB. Nothing came out first: the bucket was recorded at exactly 390 and the fix is a correctness
change with no dead weight to trade, so the ratchet moves by the one KiB it needs. 2026-11-10 (US-MATCH-009): total 548 -> 550 — the loadout mapping in the lobby and the practice
starter kit, so the item tray a player picked is no longer empty in every match.
